name: Hollow Body Rock
steps: Lie on your back, press your lower back flat into the floor, and extend your arms overhead and legs straight slightly off the ground.
Lift your shoulder blades slightly off the floor to lock your torso into a tight, shallow curved banana shape.
Initiate a smooth, controlled rock backward toward your shoulder blades and forward toward your glutes without changing your body shape.
Continue rocking rhythmically through your tight core shape before lowering your limbs gently to finish.
tips: Hold one fixed curved shape throughout the rock rather than kicking your legs or flailing your arms.
Bend your knees slightly or bring your arms to your sides if your lower back lifts off the floor.
